No call came and I'm sorry. That is three times now, and you shouldn't have to keep writing in to chase it.

Here is what I did overnight so the morning isn't wasted. I put the whole thing back in front of the team marked for first thing at 10am ET today, with your number, (phone hidden), and the three missed calls on the record. I also checked our warehouse: there are Thor P2 units on the shelf in Chattanooga, so a replacement can go out as soon as a supervisor signs it off. That decision isn't mine to make, which is the honest reason this has stalled, but it means there is nothing to wait on stock-wise once someone picks up the file.

Your request to send back the three DC06 units is in the same note, so both get answered together rather than one at a time.

Nothing is needed from you in the meantime. Keep the empty box and its packing as it is, keep the DC06 units boxed, and whatever is decided comes to you here in writing as well as by phone.

What I can do is make sure the call reaches you. Your case is at the top of the list for 10am ET this morning, with your number and the three missed attempts on it. If you tell me a window that suits you today, I'll put it on the file right away so they ring you then.
